title: DConf 2019: All Spreadsheets Must Die -- Robert Schadek
summary: A DConf 2019 talk by Robert Schadek arguing that spreadsheets are the world's dominant programming language and that D can be used to replace them. It looks at spreadsheet quirks and then at techniques for moving away from them.
why: Mostly appears as a link in Who is hiring job posts from a company using D, and once as deeper background in a thread about Excel.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: There was a talk at DConf about this with a bit more depth than what I've written here
